recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Body: Kyle and Serena Denton are community herbalists creating wild-crafted and organic plant medicines out of Milwaukee since 2015. These products work, not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Katherine's Path to Animal Communication", "body": "Katherine described a lifelong closeness to animals that she said became clearer when she pursued Dao healing and her spiritual channels opened. She explained that she first resisted the gift, wishing for something grander, then found that people kept bringing her their pets and were moved by what she relayed. She named her work soul communication and said animals share through images, a knowing, inner hearing, or by using her voice. Chance added that the healer's own openness is the real medicine and the rituals mostly help clients trust."}, {"title": "Receiving Love From Our Pets", "body": "Katherine argued that people tend to treat pets like children to be looked after, and that the missing half of the relationship is sitting down to receive the love animals offer, which she called their job. She said animals are masters of frequency and vibration without a monkey mind, and she suggested the love peace harmony song for a puppy caught in what she read as a past life loop. Chance said an earlier reading of his dog Gimli had shown him that the dog saw him as a brother more than a dad."}, {"title": "Live Readings for Chat and Call-Ins", "body": "Much of the show was Katherine reading the pets that viewers shared. For Izzy, the dog belonging to Legs and Buffalo, she described changes at home and baby chickens, and Chance relayed that the couple confirmed they were moving and planned to get chickens. She read a feral cat as an ancestral relative of a passed pet, gave a message from Vincent and his falcon guide, and passed along messages from Oliver the gecko, Juno the cat, and the goats Maybeline and Jupiter."}, {"title": "Gordy, the Owls, and Earth Pipes", "body": "Gordy joined live and spoke about cooking with intention, saying he believed food carries the feeling of the cook, and about meditating under a tree beside two owls. He said the owls vanished for several months after work on a nearby cell tower, then returned the Monday after he placed organite earth pipes from Mitch around the area. Chance added that simple harmonious tools can restore balance, using metronomes syncing together as his image. Katherine read the owls as protective teachers, and she said her own dog had been affected by 5G."}, {"title": "Oneness, Birds, and Symbols", "body": "Chance connected the conversation to the green language and the old idea of the language of the birds, arguing that all living beings share one life force energy even though the vessels differ. He read the Yijing lake trigram as joyous multiplicity, with each being at the center of its own mandala. He pointed to a viewer's image of the sphenoid bone resembling an owl as a symbol of inner and outer sight, and he tied the dove card from an animal oracle deck to asking what peace would do in each moment."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Katherine O'Shea is an animal communicator and all around super-psychic. We had fun exploring the messages we may have missed from the soul level of our pets and animal companions.
